periods.time: Seven Stars first-round B-block through second-round A-block
periods.label: 烈风剑帝等待红莲觉醒
periods.affiliation: Akatsuki Academy guest; Kurogane family; Tsukikage/Itsuki side by convenience

status.current: wins A-block second-round match against Renji Kaga and continues pursuing a decisive battle with Stella

personality.summary: Austere, strength-obsessed and dismissive of politics; he cooperates with schemes only when they serve his hunt for an absolute trial.
fears: an unresolved terror symbolized by his trembling right hand

relationships.stella-vermillion: Target whose world-class magical capacity he wants awakened so he can face overwhelming power and overcome his fear.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother; Ouma allows him to stay overnight and reveals enough motives to regain some of Ikki's respect.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Father whose request led Ouma to assist Tsukikage's anti-League plan as a convenient side arrangement.
relationships.bakuga-tsukikage: Political ally of convenience; Ouma is uninterested in Tsukikage's full plan.
relationships.renji-kaga: A-block second-round opponent defeated before the schedule compression is discussed.

periods.summary: Ouma watches Stella's Brute Dragon Roar from the VIP area and is the first to help contain it with a wind wall because he does not want her to restrain herself again. That reaction confirms for Stella and others that her full power can be contained, while Ouma is excited by her awakened spirit. Later Ikki takes refuge in Ouma's room, and Ouma explains that he is not truly Rebellion but a guest student aligned with Tsukikage because Itsuki asked him to help the anti-League plan. His real reason remains Stella: he believes magic power is the force by which knights impose their destiny, and only Stella's world-best capacity can become an absolute, inescapable threat he needs to overcome. The next day he defeats Renji Kaga in A-block second round, remaining on course in the tournament.

key_events.summary: Uses wind to help direct Stella's blast away from spectators.
Explains his alignment with Tsukikage and obsession with Stella's absolute potential.
Wins A-block second-round match against Steel Grizzly Renji Kaga.
